headline: Executive order creates federal advisory committees to help coordinate how the government enforces intellectual property laws.
what_it_does: This order sets up advisory committees inside the federal government focused on enforcing intellectual property laws, such as those covering copyrights, patents, and trademarks. The committees are meant to advise on and coordinate the government's enforcement work. No summary was provided, so details about membership and duties are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in intellectual property enforcement
who_it_affects.how: Agency officials may serve on or work with the new committees to coordinate enforcement efforts.

who_it_affects.group: Owners of copyrights, patents, and trademarks
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected indirectly if the committees change how the government enforces their rights.
